item.title: Saks Fifth Avenue to close Stony Point store this spring as part of bankruptcy case
item.description: The South Richmond store is one of eight Saks Fifth Avenue locations across several states scheduled to close along with a Massachusetts location of Neiman Marcus. Stony Point's owner said on Tuesday that it was committed to its long-range plans to invest in the mall property.
